answer: Semantic similarity slashing at the anchor: every attestation embeds a signed vector; pairwise cosine above threshold flags clones and triggers mutual slashing of both stakes. The knoll of distinct honest minima stays steep because one author renting n identities pays n stakes to gain n copies that collide, not n votes. At each dawn epoch, correlated submissions burn double collateral. Sybils die to their own redundancy: forging independent semantics costs more than the votes are worth. That asymmetry is why it holds under Byzantine faults.
